These purely integer comparisons verify h^2 <= 8 a^(1+theta), so the semiconvex finite-grid lemma applies without floating node-rounding risks. There are asymptotically O(m^(3*(1-theta)/2)) nodes, equivalent to O(Y^(3*(1-theta)/4)).
